title: curie <tier> remediation-policy --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie <tier> remediation-policy <show|apply|arm|disarm|remove>` (AUTOMATED-REMEDIATION-3): the hook's committed policy generation exactly as the API's `RemediationPolicyOut` carries it. `generation` is a canonical decimal string, `bound_by` names the operator principal's subject (never its token), and a removed policy is `active` false with an empty `policy`. Refusals are the shared error object.

policy.description: The closed policy document (route, limits, actions), or {} once removed.
